proposal.summary: Integer Overflow vulnerability in RELIC before commit 34580d840469361ba9b5f001361cad659687b9ab allows attackers to execute arbitrary code, cause a denial of service, and escalate privileges when calling realloc function in bn_grow function.
proposal.cwe_quote: Integer Overflow vulnerability in RELIC before commit 34580d840469361ba9b5f001361cad659687b9ab, allows attackers to execute arbitrary code, cause a denial of service, and escalate privileges when calling realloc function in bn_grow function.

C.quote: allows attackers to execute arbitrary code

I.quote: allows attackers to execute arbitrary code

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and apply the upstream fix at commit 34580d840469361ba9b5f001361cad659687b9ab, backport the patch to affected releases, and coordinate disclosure with users of RELIC.
